claims.value: Microsoft multilingual text embedding model (270M parameters) using decoder-only architecture with last-token pooling and L2 normalization for tasks like retrieval, clustering, and semantic similarity.
claims.evidence: harrier-oss-v1 is a family of multilingual text embedding models developed by Microsoft. The models use decoder-only architectures with last-token pooling and L2 normalization
harrier-oss-v1 is a family of multilingual text embedding models... They can be applied to a wide range of tasks, including but not limited to retrieval...
